description: Connect ChatGPT to your Clarier workspace to review your organization’s AI tools, vendor risk reports, AI usage, requests, approvals, and compliance insights. You can prepare a new AI-tool request or tool update, review the proposed changes, and explicitly confirm before Clarier applies them. Clarier uses your existing company membership, role, and permissions.

defaultPrompt: Use Clarier to summarize my organization’s AI tool estate, including approved, under-review, and discovered tools.
Use Clarier to show the vendor risk report and current approval status for an AI tool.
Help me prepare a new AI tool request in Clarier. Show every field and wait for my approval before submitting it.
